desc: The Viridian RFX1 is the smallest green dot optic on the market and the only one purpose-built for the world’s most popular subcompact pistols. Engineered for the Smith & Wesson Bodyguard 2.0, it delivers true everyday carrying performance with zero bulk, weighing in at just0.53 oz (15g). This makes it ideal for users who demand speed, reliability, and concealability in a single package.
